decision: What are the measurable rules of our brand voice, taken from writing we already agree sounds like us?
limitations: It applies rules to the text you paste: reading grade, sentence length, person, contractions, hedges and buzzwords. It can't capture character or tone, and can't see how readers respond.
The rules are only as good as the samples. One writer's favourites, or off-brand pieces marked on-brand, give rules for the wrong voice. Samples under 100 words are not counted.
The agreement limits (three grades, eight words of sentence length), the grade-plus-one ceiling and the house buzzword list are AAJ engine rules, not standards.
A word the on-brand samples use is flagged, not banned, and someone has to decide. The passive-voice figure is an estimate.
review: Whoever owns the brand confirms the team agrees the on-brand samples sound right and decides on every flagged word before the profile goes to brand-voice-governance. The adjectives, do/don't list and examples are still written by hand.
